entities.summary: Robert Scot Shields is an American former professional baseball relief pitcher. He played his entire baseball career with the Los Angeles Angels of Anaheim of Major League Baseball (MLB). He was the last member of the Angels' 2002 World Series championship team remaining on the team's roster when he announced his retirement in 2011. Shields pitched in 491 games for the Angels, ranking him second all-time in games pitched for the team behind Troy Percival (579).
